endorsements.name: Alex Rothman Shostack
endorsements.label: DEF CON Comedy Jam Part VII, Is This The One With The Whales?
endorsements.description: Weeeeeeeeee're baaaaaack. Bring out your FAIL. It's the most talked about panel at DEF CON! A standing room only event with a wait list at the door. Nothing is sacred, not the industry, not the audience, not even each other. Last year we raised over $2000 for the EFF and over $5000 over the last 5 years, let's see how much we can raise this year....
